title: Founding GTM Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI software team as its founding go-to-market engineer. You will turn prospective customer problems into practical demos, repeatable workflows, and a clearer path from initial conversation to regular product use.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build working demos and integrations around problems prospective users bring to the team.

 - Partner with the founder to test target users, use cases, and the factors that drive continued product use.

 - Connect product, sales, and onboarding data to identify where users get stuck and which changes help.

 - Build and test thoughtful go-to-market workflows that avoid noisy outreach and unsupported product claims.

 - Translate customer feedback into product improvements and clear documentation.

 - Preserve customer data permissions, access boundaries, and approval steps across connected tools.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience writing code, connecting APIs, and explaining technical work clearly to customers.

 - Evidence of building a workflow, integration, or product used by real people, and adapting it based on feedback.

 - Experience running focused go-to-market experiments, measuring outcomes, and stopping approaches that do not work.

 - Good judgment about customer data permissions and approval boundaries when connecting tools.

 - Interest in a broad-ownership founding role with direct user contact.


LOCATION

Fully remote, based in Serbia, Poland, or another Eastern European country. Working-hour overlap and local employment or contractor arrangements are to be confirmed.
